subtitle.ar: حديثان في طلب العلم والطاعة، من مقدمة كتاب المقصود في الصرف
subtitle.en: Two hadiths on seeking knowledge and on obedience, from the preface of al-Maqsud
subtitle.tr: İlim talebi ve itaat hakkında iki hadis — Maksûd'un mukaddimesinden

attribution.ar: حديثان منقولان من مقدمة دروس المقصود (وهو ثالث كتب الصرف في المدرسة)، مضبوطان ومقطَّعان للدراسة.
attribution.en: Two hadiths quoted in the preface of the Maqsud lesson notes supplied by the project owner — al-Maqsud being the third sarf text of the madrasah curriculum, after the Emsile and the Bina. The surrounding exposition there is in Ottoman Turkish; only its Arabic quotations are used. Wording to be checked against a critical hadith edition before publication.
